decision.rationale: A fixed Gemini snapshot with bounded health-aware transport fallback removes the single-endpoint failure mode without starting another reviewer-model search.
limitations: Gemini has not produced an attempt-005 live calibration vote.
Provider fallback improves availability but may use different Google service tiers across calls; each route is therefore recorded.
Codex is an immutable reviewer artifact rather than a new API call.
LLM agreement remains silver evidence, and the 200-case product panel is unopened.
